title: PolicyDecision
description:
The record of one policy evaluation, written to the event log as POLICY_EVALUATED.

`basis` is the field ADR-014 is built on. It is required and it is a tagged union rather than a nullable rule id, because an action that passed with no rule engaged must be distinguishable from one a rule deliberately permitted. A null would read as 'no information'; `unmatched` reads as 'nothing governed this', and the unmatched fraction over a window is the honest measure of how much behaviour is actually governed.

policyVersion.description: Which policy produced this. A decision made before a policy change must remain interpretable after it.

consideredRuleIds.description: Every rule that matched, strictest first — not only the winner. A rule that fires constantly but never wins is a vacuous rule, and one that never fires at all is dead; both are tracked and both are bugs (ADR-014).
